items.title: Branford Marsalis — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: But Decoy was killing. You know, Miles has this aura, he just makes you a better player. For a long time, the soprano solos I played on that record were like the best representation of me playing

ctx.x: That was killing. But we weren’t playing Cindi Lauper tunes. But that’s where it was going. I thought we were going to do the shit we did on Decoy. I said, “I can’t wait to do this.” Cause that’s kinda like, [you know…] a less complicated version like the Bitches Brew stuff, or the In A Silent Way stuff. Blues-oriented and…just really killing music. It was great. Scofield was killing. You know what I mean? It was a great…. The whole band experience. Robert Irving the third, it was great. The whole thing was…
How about working with Grateful Dead?
